ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Morph accesses your photo library when you choose photos or videos to process. Your files stay on this device.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Morph saves photos and videos to your library only when you ask it to.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Morph uses the camera when you take a photo or scan a document. Photos stay on this device.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Morph uses the microphone when you record audio. Recordings stay on this device.
ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Morph transcribes recordings on this device when you run speech to text. Recordings stay on this device.
